method: Actual production browser STL Viewer controls, manually observed 2026-11-01; no numerical section measurement.
retainedSide: Z greater than or equal to selected coordinate
camera: Reset view default oblique (+X,+Y,+Z); V2 at 5% also rotated two 90-degree turns for opposite-side comparison. No cap generated.

records.visibleObservation: Below the 1.2 mm base transition; cavity and enclosing walls visible, with walls obscuring part of the cut.
Above the base; the cavity is exposed through the uncapped cut. Camera rotation changes which wall obscures it.
Nearby position above the base; cavity remains exposed, rear and side surfaces occlude part of the view.
Just below the 1.4 mm recess floor; the shallow glyph recesses retain their floor surfaces.
Within the recess interval; clipped floors no longer obscure the background through the grooves. The O island can appear detached in the display.
Nearby position within the same recess; narrow grooves remain visible with no generated cap.
